## HERA — resolve the censored onset before the electron Landau fan

> **05:21** · SdH onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, D=0, B 0.3→1.5 T, 361 inverse-B points, 10 nA, base T · **ETA ~05:56** (≈35 min)

`sdh-spot-check` Verify and `landau-fan` cost-floor gate require a measured onset. Run 6 at n=+3.2 has a censored onset on its adequately sampled B≥1 T segment; its coarser data below 1 T cannot resolve F_L=33.1 T. This short extension repeats the same density, range and settling on a different grid, overlaps 1–1.5 T for consistency, and provides the lower-field record needed to price the single electron fan. Read-only preflight verifies the committed card validators and the handoff state before moving anything.

361 points at uniform Δ(1/B)=0.007407 T⁻¹ give 4.08 points per 33.1 T period (3.63 at the secondary-ridge +0.337 density offset); the upper field is 1.5 T. Start from the measured handoff 0 T: positioning 0→0.3 T costs 2.19 min, measured traverse 0.3→1.5 T has an 8.76 min bare ramp floor. Runs 6/7 show ≈3.08 s fixed cost per field point after subtracting ΔB/0.137 T/min; 361 points add 18.5 min. Allow 35 min including preflight and margin. Preserve 50 µV sensitivity and ≥3 s driver settle (10τ at 24 dB/oct); this is an onset measurement, not a stacking verdict. Gates remain at the shared electron point, field at 1.5 T for the following fan.

Check the first 25 points and every 10 min for current, clipping, temperature and leakage; abort on anomalies and read actual state. All acquired channels are plotted. Magnet interrupt does **not** stop an in-progress supply ramp on this VTI; contact Zack for a supply stop if needed. The field steps are small and within the 10 T cap.

    assert _actual==_expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10. and T_SESSION_CAP==100.

_Ts,_Tv=T_sample(),T_vaporizer()
_B=magnet.field(); _Vsi=k_si()
print('Expected base T 1–1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K tracking within .6 K, Si 0 V; actual',_Ts,_Tv,_Vsi,'B',_B)

assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
print('Expected handoff field 0 T; actual',_B)
assert abs(_B)<.05
_vtg,_vbg=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
assert -.3<=_vtg<=1. and -1.3<=_vbg<=2.
B_vec=field_invB(.3,1.5,361)
assert np.max(np.abs(B_vec))<=B_SESSION_CAP
assert magnet.settle_s>=3.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # restore run-6 range; no acquisition scale change across overlap
mc=dict(meas_config); mc['Si (V)']=_Vsi; mc['sample_temperature:']=_Ts
mc['comments']='SdH onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; calibration run 5; B .3→1.5 T uniform inverse B 361 points; 10 nA; sr1 50 uV; .3 s/24 dB; run-6 overlap'
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check'); s.add_comment(mc['comments'])
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,_vbg); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,_vtg)
interruptible_sleep(10)
s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for _p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P): s.plot(magnet.field,_p)
# Row [time,B,Ts,Tv,Itg,Ibg,Ix,Ip,Vx,Vp]
def onset_guard(station,data):
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(data)) or not 1.0<=data[2]<=1.5 or data[3]>=1.6 or max(abs(data[4]),abs(data[5]))>1e-9:
        print('STOP: onset acquisition guard',data); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0.)
print('END actual B/TG/BG/Si/T:',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt(),k_si(),T_sample())
